A separate standard-library exact-rational grounded-Laplacian test checks all 693 columns for \(2\le m,n\le7\).

value.rationale: The exact sensitivity of canonical cut/cycle endpoint operator norms to removing one edge from any rectangular biclique is a motivated graph-decomposition stability invariant. A strict two-to-one deficit and simultaneous localization of the maxima on edges disjoint from the deletion are structural facts; neither follows just from entrywise Laplacian downdate monotonicity. This gives an exact perturbation benchmark across an infinite two-parameter family.
